title: Human Preferences for Constructive Interactions in Language Model Alignment
reasoning: The paper evaluates Large Language Model alignment through the lens of human values and 'bridging attributes' such as compassion and respect, which are ethical and moral constructs. It specifically analyzes how users' beliefs regarding AI value alignment (i.e., whether AI should reflect their personal values and cultural perspectives) influence their preferences, and it cites religious bias as a significant concern in current models.
